as_told.title: S force operatives Rip Robertson and Ed Lansdale photographed in Dealey Plaza

plain: Photographs are said to show a man named Rip Robertson, whom the teller calls "the field operations commander for the S force", standing in Dealey Plaza in Dallas when President Kennedy was shot in 1963. The lawyer and researcher Daniel Sheehan says this on the show without naming where the pictures come from, and in one telling he also places a man named Ed Lansdale there beside Robertson. If true, it would put a covert operations commander at the scene of the killing.
